result.title: Neural Implicit Energy Optimization for LiDAR Mapping
result.summary: Neural implicit representations provide memory-efficient signed distance field (SDF) parameterizations for large-scale LiDAR scenes, but the geometry recovered from sparse and often noisy inputs carries jitter and artifacts. Classical geometric optimization techniques resolve such artifacts with surface energy functionals, whose minimizers correspond to smooth surfaces. Motivated by this principle, we formulate neural LiDAR mapping as the optimization of energy functionals over the parameter space of neural implicit representations. Specifically, we regularize the signed distance field with an energy functional defined on the shape operator of its level set, which represents the curvature of the surface, thus encouraging smoothness along the surface. This adapts classical geometric priors to the scale of million-point LiDAR maps. Experiments on large-scale datasets show reconstructions with improved smoothness at preserved geometric fidelity, and no additional inference-time cost. The code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/nieo}{https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/nieo}

AI.brief_summary: 该工作将大规模 LiDAR 建图表述为神经隐式 SDF 参数空间上的能量泛函优化，用以抑制稀疏噪声输入带来的抖动与伪影。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是三维几何重建与表面平滑先验，未涉及多模态推理状态、证据使用或停止决策，所提曲率能量正则与 LVR 的 latent 表示或计算控制也无具体可核查的方法线索。
